entities.summary: Aaron Haroon Rashid, known simply by his mononym Haroon, is a British-born Pakistani singer-songwriter, pop star, director, music producer, composer, script-writer and social activist. He has also won a Peabody Award as a creator, director and producer for Burka Avenger.
